It did not distinguish authoritative codec semantics from project/runtime bindings, nor apply the approved rule that N/A requires positive project-SPEC proof rather than an unsupported command or missing package.
disposition_reason: Resolve Engineering Decision Pending and BLOCKED. NVIDIA NVDEC documentation explicitly defines VC-1 Simple/Main/Advanced profile decoding and separates decoded frames from display rendering. A complete review-layer test can capability-gate the exact GPU/API, require a project-approved immutable VC-1 conformance/reference stream, compare all decoded frames/timestamps to a pinned golden manifest, and preserve the physical display check. Missing file/device/display values are runtime configuration. If the exact project platform lacks VC-1, N/A is allowed only when the approved Project SPEC states VC-1 decode is not required; tool absence or hardware failure alone cannot create N/A.
decision_basis: The exact XLSX row 1786, same-row DeepSeek/test-json content, GPT V2, historical V3.1 record, Round-2 UNRESOLVED result, pending/blocked analyses, ED-01 through ED-30 and official NVIDIA/FFmpeg documentation were read. The next formal identity was directly opened as Functionality row 1787 / Wistron-HW-00420-V002 / 819e112aeaea6b7c.
Decode and display are coherent. DeepSeek's request for an unverified VC-1 encoder is outside the protected source and is discarded rather than treated as a Source Conflict.

NVIDIA lists VC-1 Simple, Main and Advanced profiles for NVDEC and defines capability query plus decoded-YUV and presentation stages. This establishes a standard method while still requiring proof for the exact GPU, driver and stream profile.

VC-1 configuration must distinguish elementary/container form, profile/level, progressive/interlaced coding, field order, frame dimensions/rate, range/color metadata and output pixel/deinterlace policy. Those values belong to the immutable project stream/golden contract.

PASS requires exact input metadata/hash, positive hardware capability and selected-decoder/no-fallback evidence, complete frame/timestamp and golden signature match, clean events, and full connector-bound visual observation.

Per the approved N/A rule, an unsupported decoder does not automatically pass or become N/A. It is FAIL/BLOCKED unless the approved Project SPEC explicitly excludes VC-1 for this exact platform; such a clause and platform identity are retained as N/A evidence.
No VC-1 probe, encode/decode, GPU workload, scratch write, playback, display inspection, log clear or DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: VC-1 profile/capability-gated hardware decode and physical display
test_case.purpose: Validate the exact project VC-1 profile is supported and hardware-decoded on the bound GPU with deterministic frame integrity, then displayed completely without profile, interlace, color, crop or edge artifacts; allow N/A only from explicit platform SPEC evidence.
required_package: Approved Project SPEC declaring VC-1 required scope or an explicit exact-platform not-applicable clause; exact server/GPU identity
Immutable known-good VC-1 stream/reference and SHA-256 with container/elementary form, Simple/Main/Advanced profile, dimensions/rates, progressive/interlaced/field order and color/range metadata
Golden decoded `framemd5`, expected frame/timestamp sequence and pinned output pixel/deinterlace policy
Exact GPU serial/UUID/BDF, driver/VBIOS and ffmpeg/ffprobe build with approved VC-1 NVDEC path, capability query and verbose no-fallback proof
Bounded scratch/evidence path, connector/display/mode/player/capture route, qualified operator, health/event thresholds and recovery plan
test_case.test_command: PARAMETERIZED REVIEW-LAYER PROCEDURE — do not execute until bindings are approved. First bind exact platform and inspect the Project SPEC: if and only if it explicitly excludes VC-1, record N/A with clause, revision and identities and do not run. Otherwise verify input/golden hashes, scratch capacity, GPU health and positive VC-1 profile capability. Record `ffprobe -v error -show_streams -show_format -show_frames -select_streams v:0 -of json "$VC1_INPUT"` and require configured profile, container, scan/field/color/range, dimensions/rates/duration and frame expectations. Record ffmpeg build/decoder/hardware capabilities. Run `ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel repeat+level+verbose -hwaccel "$APPROVED_HWACCEL" -hwaccel_device "$GPU_SELECTOR" -i "$VC1_INPUT" -map 0:v:0 -an -vf "$APPROVED_HW_DOWNLOAD_PIXEL_FORMAT_AND_DEINTERLACE_POLICY" -f framemd5 "$ACTUAL_FRAMEMD5"`. Require bound hardware-decoder/no-fallback evidence and exact manifest/frame/timestamp match. Play the complete same stream through the approved connector-bound route, collect time-correlated operator evidence, then final health/events. Stop on any anomaly; do not retry.
test_case.expected_result: For required scope, the exact VC-1 profile is positively supported on the bound device, input/golden metadata and hashes match, the hardware decoder is proven without fallback, every expected frame/timestamp/signature matches, and ffmpeg exits 0 without parser/decoder errors. Full physical playback has no corruption, unapproved combing/field-order issue, color/range error, tearing, freeze, crop/aspect or edge artifact; health/events remain acceptable. N/A is valid only with explicit approved SPEC exclusion for the exact platform.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires all capability, decoder, deterministic integrity, health and visual checks. FAIL on required-but-unsupported capability, fallback, wrong profile/input/GPU, parser/decoder error, frame/timestamp/signature mismatch, truncated playback, visual defect, nonzero exit or health breach. BLOCKED at runtime when required configuration/evidence is absent. N/A only with retained Project SPEC clause/revision and exact platform identity; package absence, command failure or a generic product statement is insufficient. End user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Reject the DeepSeek encoder-to-null proposal; never infer VC-1 decode support from an encoder name or software fallback.
Capability-gate the exact device/profile before workload; preserve explicit Project SPEC proof for any N/A under ED-13.
Verify immutable input/golden hashes and bound profile/interlace/color/output contract; write only approved bounded scratch.
Preserve logs/events and keep machine frame integrity separate from real connector-bound visual evidence.
Stop on unsupported required capability, fallback, media/visual/GPU/thermal/storage/evidence failure. Do not retry, reset, reboot, clear logs or alter firmware/configuration automatically.
expected_evidence: Project SPEC applicability clause/revision and exact server/GPU identity; if N/A, the explicit exclusion and approval
Exact GPU/driver/VBIOS/ffmpeg identities, positive decoder capability, selected hardware path and no-fallback verbose log
Complete actual `framemd5`, golden comparison, exit status, connector/display/mode and full-clip time-correlated operator visual record
Scratch/capacity proof, preserved pre/during/post health/events, no-retry audit, recovery/final state and end-user verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop the decoder/player on the first unsupported-required, decoder, integrity, visual or health failure; preserve all media, capability results, manifests, captures and events and do not retry. Remove only approved scratch after evidence retention and restore only the approved display/session state. Escalate under project recovery without reset, reboot or firmware action.
